correctness.rationale: Gale evenness identifies tetrahedra as unordered pairs of vertex-disjoint cycle edges. A hyperplane sign word has at most four cyclic changes by a degree<=4 polynomial, and every such mixed word is realizable. Counting mixed tetrahedra gives F=pq+rn-r^2-5r+s; compare 2 versus 4 sign changes and control singleton runs. A polar stability argument bounds nongeneric sections. Euler and 2+2 colored tetrahedra determine f-vector and quadrilateral count. Independent own exact Gale-evenness/disjoint-cycle enumeration across n=5..12 gave sharp maxima (5,9,14,20,26,33,...) and matched F. This finite arithmetic checks the proof but is not extrapolated to all n.
